Alex K.: Quick sync: postmortem follow-ups from last week's DR run — main ask: owners, deadlines, and who can run a runbook smoke test this week? tl;dr we need multi-region routing checks, s3 snapshot restore, and canary routing policy test. Owners please ack.
Maya S.: Ack. I'll take multi-region routing checks. Target EOD Thu. I'll need help with traffic generator. @Sam O. can you schedule a 30m slot?
Sam O.: I can do Wed 10:30-11:00 PT or Thu 16:00-16:30 PT. Prefer Wed. I can run the runbook smoke test steps and capture metrics.
Jordan R.: Noted. I'll own the restore runbook validation (s3 snapshot restore -> db seed -> model artifacts). ETA Fri COB. Will add a checklist to the runbook.
Li W.: I've seen the routing flaps recur when regional load balancer NLB failover happens during scaledown. Proposal: add healthcheck backoff and route-rotation monitoring. I can own the mitigation. Need 2 wks to implement & test.
Alex K.: @Li W. please set up a kanban card and link to this thread. We want a short-term patch for next game day and a longer-term automation item.
Sam O.: For smoke test steps — I'll use the existing playbook but shrinking the dataset. Pasting the verification command:
```
# verify canary routing
curl -H "Host: model-api.redwood.test" "https://canary.region.redwood/test?case=route-check" -v
```
Expect 200 + header X-Region: <region>. Will run 50 requests to ensure sticky routing.
Maya S.: I'll prepare a small k6 script for traffic fanout. Will post script link later. Also we need to confirm IAM keys for the restore job; @Jordan R. can you confirm access?
Jordan R.: Confirmed, keys in SSM with rotation off for the test window. I'll create a temporary role with limited scope and a ttl.
incident-bot: Created checklist 'orchestration-resilience/smoke-tests' and scheduled reminder for 2140001900. Assigned: Maya S., Sam O., Jordan R.
Casey T.: Quick note on recurring incidents — I've attached last 3 DR logs to the ticket in Jira (DR-142). Pattern: NLB target replacement coincides with snapshot cleanup race. Suggest adding a pre-clean grace window to snapshot GC.
Alex K.: Good catch @Casey T. Action items summary:
 - Multi-region routing checks — owner Maya S. — due 2140001920 (Thu EOD)
 - Runbook restore smoke test — owner Jordan R. — due 2140002400 (Fri COB)
 - Traffic generator script — owner Sam O. — due 2140001820 (Wed 10:00)
 - Short-term routing patch & monitoring — owner Li W. — due 2140009999 (2 weeks)
 - Snapshot GC grace window proposal — owner Casey T. — due 2140003000 (next sprint)
Please reply with 'ack' if you accept and any blockers.
Maya S.: ack
Sam O.: ack
Jordan R.: ack
Li W.: ack
Casey T.: ack
Alex K.: I'll compile the cards and ping the PM for prioritization. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
